Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/02/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 273 as introduced would exempt individuals engaged in the production of farm products from payment of any license or fee to a county for the sale of farm products produced by the farmer. This bill could decrease receipts to the various counties by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of any such licensee fees exempted pursuant to this bill.
Larry Stutts, Chairperson
Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry
